name: Data retention
usage: Declare every personal or growing data class once: const policy = retentionPolicy([{ name: "audit.events", table: "audit_event", column: "created_at", days: 365 }, ...]) (key defaults to "id"; there is no default period, and how long each class is kept is the app owner's decision). Register purgeJob(query, policy) as an SM-05 handler (e.g. "retention.purge") and enqueue it daily; it deletes only rows whose age column is older than the period, in batches (batchSize, maxBatches), and stops on the job's abort signal. Index each age column. The review (SM-08-L1) checks that every growing table is in the policy. Rows past their period are deleted for good: a class that soft-deletes first (a recycle bin) sets column to its deleted_at, so only rows deleted longer ago than the period are purged.
